nodes.title: Base62 id codec
nodes.goal: Export encode(n) and decode(s) converting between non-negative integers and base62 strings. Round-trip must be exact. Reject negative and non-integer input.
mutations: the alphabet ordering is digits-last instead of digits-first, so round-trip works but ids differ
decode does not reject an empty string and returns 0

nodes.title: In-memory link store
nodes.goal: Export a createStore() factory with put(url), get(id), and has(id). Ids come from an injected id generator so the store stays testable.
mutations: has() returns true for an id that was never stored because it checks the prototype chain

nodes.title: Shorten service
nodes.goal: Export shorten(url) and resolve(id), wiring the codec to the store. Validate that the url has an http or https scheme before storing.
nodes.notes: Do not add a database. The store is injected.
mutations: url validation accepts any string containing '://' rather than requiring http or https

nodes.title: HTTP routes
nodes.goal: Export a request handler exposing POST /api/links and GET /:id. POST returns 201 with the short id, GET returns 302 or 404.
nodes.acceptance: An unknown id must never leak whether it was previously used. 404 for both cases.
mutations: an unknown id returns 410 for a previously-used id and 404 otherwise, leaking prior existence
